Runes › Sorcery

Axiom Arcanist

SorceryRow 1

Your ultimate deals more damage and gives more healing and shielding, and takedowns lower its current cooldown.

What it does

Your Ultimate has 12% increased damage, healing, and shielding. (AoE damage is reduced to a 8% increase) Scoring a takedown on an enemy champion reduces your Ultimate's current cooldown by 7%.

When to take it

Pick it when your ultimate is a big part of your damage or healing. The bonus is smaller for area damage.

Good on

Garen Cho'Gath Fiddlesticks Karthus Annie Twitch

Other runes in this row

Manaflow Band Nimbus Cloak

In our champion builds

Annie MidSecondary tree (Sorcery)
